mentions.name: Lumirank
mentions.description: Lumirank provides analytics for AI chat and search, letting brands track what AI assistants recommend when asked questions like "best running shoe".
mentions.problem: Brands lack visibility into what AIs recommend when asked about their product category.
mentions.audience: Brands (e.g., product brands) that want to track what AI assistants recommend when users ask questions about their category.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am working on analytics for AI chat and search. Suppose you have a sports shoe brand, then you would like to track what AIs recommend when they are asked "best running shoe".
mentions.author: ghoshbishakh
